banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Choose a supported native swap target/configuration and explain why retaining the old slot does not preserve former workers or active work.
stageScope: Standalone A-card learning exercise with BDD, Node built-in RED/GREEN tests, and real local-file browser interaction. Not B-S002 native proof or complete D-S002 acceptance.

assumptions: Compatible shared state and sufficient overlap/dependency headroom are synthetic preconditions, not measured facts.
Only three named non-secret slot-specific aliases are modeled; identity, network, authentication and other configuration still need qualification.
No runtime framework or hosting contract is approved by choosing a fixture.

scenarios: Prepare staging using effective production settings; restart and meaningfully warm both instances before production-target routing.
Block wrong target, source-only configuration, incompatibility, unready/500 responses, broad status policy, unsupported auto-swap and unknown selections.
Retained old slot does not prevent former-worker recycling; opaque active-work outcomes remain unknown.
Interrupted request/connection/job can be a detected negative teaching result, never uninterrupted migration.
Deterministic logical trace, independent assertions, original journey budgets and unmeasured real work limits.
Keyboard operation and bounded local reset/cleanup.

tdd.runner: Node.js v22.23.4 built-in node:test; no dependencies or package installation
tdd.outputNormalization: Absolute user paths replaced with repository-relative paths; trailing whitespace removed from captured output. Assertions, messages, exit codes and test results are preserved.

red.cause: Actual behavior assertion failures against an importable minimal stub, including unimplemented instead of rehearsed. Not missing imports or tools.

browserRegressionRed.cause: Browser-discovered reset method shadowing, captured before the fix.

green.scope: 26 model tests, including all 288 enumerated condition combinations and corruption/malformed-input checks; 6 static page-contract/regression tests.

assertionsObserved: Safe production target used effective target settings, two readiness steps, then routing and former-worker recycling.
Repeat selection generated an identical trace.
Wrong target and seven additional unsafe selections blocked with v1 admissions and no routing switch.
Verifier remained incomplete without acknowledgments; checkbox Space and verifier Enter produced an educational-only PASS.
Opaque impact stayed UNKNOWN/UNVERIFIED; interrupted impact stayed INTERRUPTED even when the educational verifier passed.
Changed conditions made the trace stale and disabled verification.
Keyboard Enter reset local state and returned focus to the profile control.
Instrumented reload requested only index.html, style.css, lesson.js and app.js; zero remote requests and zero page errors.
readPage used the same final owned pageId after cleanup.
browser.scopeLimit: Real browser exercise evidence, not an actual Azure swap, native worker observation, reliability claim or full accessibility audit.

verifierResult.scope: Educational assertions only; blocked negatives may pass the teaching check.

iac.reason: SOURCE-only read-only lesson. No resources are created; C001 runtime/auth/hosting decisions and separate scaffold/deploy approvals are absent.

limits: Former production workers recycle after native routing changes; retaining the old slot is not custom drain semantics.
In-flight requests, long-lived connections and background work may be abandoned/interrupted; opaque outcomes are unknown, not successful.
Retry/reconnect time remains inside the original journey budget; recovery cannot erase an interruption.
Actual maximum request/job durations, native lifecycle timing, session/authentication continuity and exactly-once/durable effects are unmeasured.
Slots share App Service plan compute; swap does not add capacity or independent fault domains.
HTTP response alone is not meaningful readiness; effective settings, dependencies, state and representative journeys need validation.
No B-S002 proof, completed D-S002 parent, live success, five-nines claim or reliability certification.

cleanup.observed: Keyboard reset cleared local selections, trace, acknowledgments, verifier and user impact; focus returned to profile.
cleanup.remainingSurface: Owned local browser page, reset to NOT RUN; safe to close.

publication.preCommitGateRecovery: The first publisher attempt rejected trailing whitespace in captured Node failure output before any commit or push. Generated logs were whitespace-normalized before retry; no Git lock, index, shared file, or other worker change was manually modified.
publication.reviewStatus: Controller empirical review and acceptance remain pending; this artifact does not mark the card Done.
